profile.summary: Earth Island Institute is a nonprofit environmental organization based in Berkeley, California. It provides fiscal sponsorship and support to many grassroots environmental projects, runs an award-winning magazine and offers leadership development programs. Bay Area Wilderness Training is one of its sponsored projects.
